description: Connect Book with Schedulo to book a meeting with a host directly in ChatGPT — see their meeting types, find open times, and reserve a slot. Sign in with your Book with Schedulo account to manage your own scheduling: view, cancel, and reschedule bookings, set your weekly availability, and get your booking link. Cancellations and reschedules ask for confirmation first and notify your guests automatically.

defaultPrompt: Reschedule my next meeting and notify the guest
